source.notes: School paper typeset as a booklet: PDF page 1 = printed page 1 (right half); PDF page 2 = printed pages 2 and 5; PDF page 3 = printed pages 3 and 4; PDF page 4 is a duplicate of PDF page 3. The PDF has a partial text layer (some lines missing); text was taken from it and completed/corrected against the page images. Printed session '2018-19'; examYear taken as the later year. Time printed as '3 Hrs. + 15 min' (durationMinutes = 180 writing time). Full Marks printed as 100, but the printed question marks add up to 70 (theory paper; the remaining 30 is presumably practical work, not stated). Marks for Q1 a) (i)-(v) are not printed; 1 each is inferred from the 70-mark total. Q20 prints (5) beside part a) only; a) and b) are kept together as one 5-mark entry, consistent with the 70-mark total.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
